reason: Count alternating permutations of {1,...,n} in two different ways. Partition by the position of the maximum n: it can occur only at even positions, and for fixed even j the permutation is determined by choosing the j-1 values to the left of n and then choosing independent alternating permutations on the left and right blocks, giving w_j. This proves the even-j sum is E_n. Partition instead by the position of the minimum 1: it can occur only at odd positions, and for fixed odd j the left block is alternating while the right block is alternating starting with a decrease; complementing values gives the same count E_{n-j} for the latter. This gives the odd-j sum as E_n.
